content: Acoustic model architecture The architecture for the convolutional acoustic model is the "high dropout" model from BIBREF11 for Librispeech, which has 19 layers in addition to the front-end (mel-filterbanks for the baseline, or the learnable front-end for our approach). On WSJ, we use the lighter version used in BIBREF17 , which has 17 layers. Dropout is applied at each layer after the front-end, following BIBREF20 . The learnable front-end uses 40 or 80 filters. Language model architecture As described in Section SECREF8 , we use the GCNN-14B model of BIBREF0 with dropout at each convolutional and linear layer on both WSJ and Librispeech. We keep all the words (162K) in WSJ training corpus. For Librispeech, we only use the most frequent 200K tokens (out of 900K).
